full_judgment: 2. Respondent No. 2, informant, lodged an FIR on 31-3-87 against the present petitioner on the accusations that the petitioner committed offences under sections 409/420/467 of the Penal Code read with section 5(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947. Prosecution case was that 0.20 acre land of plot No. 2372 and 2375 appertaining to Khatian No. 834 of mouza Satpai, Police Station Netrokona, District Netrokona was enemy property. The accused-petitioner took lease of the property for 1966-1970 on payment of lease money and mutated his name claiming title to the land upon a forged bainapatra dated 9-11-63. On preliminary enquiry it is found that the land originally belonged to Jatindra Chandra Bhattacharya and Sunil Chandra Bhattacharya who left the country in 1946 and did never come back to this country. On completion of the investigation the charge sheet was submitted against the petitioner on 24-1-89 under sections 409/420/467 of the Penal Code and GR Case No. 33(2)87 was started in the court of the Upazila Magistrate, Netrokona, which was transferred to the Court of Sessions Judge, Netrokona and was renumbered as Special Case No. 3 of 1989. The learned Sessions Judge took cognizance of the offence under the aforesaid sections on 8-2-89. On 14-2-89 the petitioner filed an application under section 265C of the Code of Criminal Procedure for discharging him on the ground that Title Suit No. 300 of 1986 was pending in the Court of Assistant Judge, Netrokona for declaration of title on the basis of the bainapatra and accordingly, the prosecution is barred under section 195(1)(c) of the Code of Criminal Procedure. The trial Court by its order dated 14-8-89 rejected it but stayed proceeding of the case till 30-9-89.
